name: react-web-plugin
description: Claude Code plugin for React web projects — Next.js (App Router) on Vercel, TypeScript strict, Tailwind CSS v4, Postgres (any provider; Supabase optional), Stripe, AWS S3, React Query, Sentry, Vitest, and Playwright. Provides a database MCP server, scaffolding, review agents, and browser preview for multi-tenant B2B dashboards.
